summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on improving the accuracy of calculating unique users, particularly for a client in Latvia. Initial concerns were raised regarding the method used (MAC + request type) being only approximate.

Alternative methods suggested included using more granular identifiers like MAC + CPU or harddrive serial numbers to achieve higher accuracy. It was also questioned whether local/trusted location data might provide more reliable unique counts for a single location.

[me] committed to reviewing documentation to find available fields, including CPU and harddrive serial number information, to improve the calculation methodology.
decisions: The final approach for calculating unique users will be discussed at tomorrow's meeting.
action_items: [me] to review documentation for advanced user identification fields (CPU, harddrive serial number).
Both parties agreed not to send direct answers regarding the client's questions until the next meeting.
